source_terrain_limitations: GOFER is hourly retrospective cumulative satellite reconstruction, not ground arrival
GOES native resolution is about 2km at equator; 100m rasterization adds no observed detail
GOFER final FRAP references and other hindsight preprocessing prevent as-of validation
Initial cumulative perimeter is not an observed active fire front everywhere
Copernicus GLO90 is surface DSM, not bare-earth DTM; later release does not prove 2019 availability
LF2016 depicts 2016 ground conditions but capable fuels may refer to 2019/2020; 2019 as-of unverified
Nearest 30m-to-100m fuel resampling loses subcell fuel mixtures and does not estimate moisture
Canopy structure is absent; canopy zeros in a surface-fire scenario are explicit assumptions
Nonburnable model categories or outside-domain cells do not imply personal safety
Future geometries are stored separately and excluded from input-domain construction
source_weather_limitations: Two-hour model-cycle lag is a fixed assumption, not historical release proof
3km wind resampled to100m does not resolve100m atmospheric processes
Archived operational forecast, not observed future weather
This US development case does not validate Korean personal risk
label_boundary: Freeze three cases and write fit receipt before opening future reconstructed labels

100m regridding does not create100m observation truth
One train event, no held-out model selection or Korean transfer validation
